ChannelInboundTextMessage.description:
Normalized text message admitted by a trusted adapter.

Identity fields are opaque and provider-scoped:

* ``external_message_id`` identifies one inbound message and is the
  idempotency key within a connection. It must remain stable across retries.
* ``conversation_key`` identifies the provider conversation, not a Runtime
  session id.
* ``sender_key`` identifies the provider peer, not a display name.
* ``principal_scope`` is assigned by Runtime connection policy and must
  equal the configured connection scope; adapters must not accept it from
  untrusted user content.

``conversation_label`` and ``sender_display_name`` are untrusted display
hints only. They must never be used for identity, authorization, memory
scope, prompt instructions, or idempotency.

account_key.description: Opaque provider-scoped account identity copied from the connection; the gateway must reject a mismatch
account_key.title: Account Key

conversation_label.description: Untrusted display label; never identity, authorization, or instruction
conversation_label.title: Conversation Label

external_message_id.description: Opaque provider-scoped inbound message identity used for idempotency; stable across retries within the connection
external_message_id.title: External Message Id

principal_scope.description: Runtime-owned privacy and memory isolation key copied from the connection; the gateway must reject a mismatch
principal_scope.title: Principal Scope

sender_display_name.description: Untrusted display label; never identity, authorization, or instruction
sender_display_name.title: Sender Display Name

sender_key.description: Opaque provider-scoped sender identity; never a display name
sender_key.title: Sender Key
